pages.title: Dakar 24V 2 Seater Ride On Buggy | Koala Play
pages.description: Order the Dakar 24V 2 seater ride on buggy with roof, parental remote and four 75W motors. Great for fun with siblings or pals. Ireland & NI delivery.
pages.ld_description:
The Dakar 24V 2 Seater Ride On Buggy is built for young drivers who want to share every adventure. With two adjustable seats and safety belts, there is plenty of room for siblings or friends to enjoy supervised outdoor play together. The powerful 24V system, 4WD setup and four 75W motors provide a confident driving experience across suitable garden surfaces, while EVA wheels and spring suspension help deliver a smoother, more comfortable ride.

Key Features

 	24V system — two 12V 7Ah batteries
 	Four 75W motors — 300W combined rated motor power
 	Two seats with safety belts
 	2.4G parental remote included
 	EVA wheels and spring suspension
 	Bluetooth music and LED lights


ALSO AVAILABLE IN PINK! CLICK HERE
 



 



 

DELIVERED ALL OVER IRELAND & N.IRELAND!
